name: Dayflower

facts.how: Raw or cooked as a mild green
facts.value: A mild green; the flowers are a garnish

caution: A safe relative of spiderwort; eat young tender growth. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Two vivid blue upper petals over a small white lower one give each flower a Mickey-Mouse look; each bloom lasts just a day.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: The tender shoots and leaves are a pleasant mild green, and the blue flowers brighten a salad.
